platforms.label: Instagram
platforms.howToConnect: Set IG_USER_ID + META_ACCESS_TOKEN (Instagram Business account). Agent Reach: `opencli instagram` via a logged-in browser session.

platforms.label: X
platforms.sourceLabel: X API v2 — recent tweet counts
platforms.howToConnect: Set X_BEARER_TOKEN (Basic tier or above). Agent Reach: `agent-reach configure twitter-cookies` + twitter-cli.

platforms.label: Facebook
platforms.howToConnect: Meta retired CrowdTangle (Aug 2024); Meta Content Library is researcher-only. Agent Reach `opencli facebook` can read pages/groups with a logged-in session.

platforms.label: Search
platforms.sourceLabel: Wikipedia daily pageviews (Google Trends has no public API)
platforms.howToConnect: For true Google Trends numbers, add a SerpApi / DataForSEO key.

platforms.label: YouTube
platforms.howToConnect: Set YOUTUBE_API_KEY, or install yt-dlp (bundled with Agent Reach).

platforms.label: Reddit
platforms.howToConnect: Public JSON now returns 403. Create a Reddit 'script' app and set REDDIT_CLIENT_ID + REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET.

notes: Intensity is cohort-relative (log-scaled across all tracked trends), so 100 = strongest tracked trend on that platform, not an absolute volume.
Google News RSS returns at most 100 items per query/edition; very large topics saturate, which compresses the top of the News column.
Search = Wikipedia pageviews as a proxy for search interest. Google Trends' explore endpoint rejects scripted clients (HTTP 429).
Platforms marked 'not connected' show no number — they are never estimated.
